color.note: Light is the morning garden, dark the night forest. Every value is a candidate the docs name as fixed in name only; contrast figures in the notes are WCAG 2 ratios measured on these values. The Gardener's voice (ai, ai-muted) is green here by the owner's decision; visual-language.md's honey/firefly pair stays as the Gardener's second colour (honey, honey-muted), for tool calls and the model chip.

tokens.name: surface-0
tokens.usage: The page. Warm paper in light, deep blue-green black in dark; never pure white or pure black.

tokens.name: surface-1
tokens.usage: Cards, the sidebar, widgets, sheets. In dark this lighter step IS the elevation: no shadow.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Inputs at rest, hover on rows and quiet buttons, skeleton rows.

tokens.name: surface-3
tokens.usage: Pressed and selected states, the active segmented-control tab, the selected sidebar item.

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on surface-0 through surface-3 (13.5:1 light, 15.3:1 dark on surface-0). Ink-green, not black.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary lines, chart labels, helper text on surface-0 through surface-3 (6.6:1 light, 8.7:1 dark on surface-0).

tokens.name: text-tertiary
tokens.usage: Subtitles beside domain names, timestamps, chart averages and goal lines, placeholder text. In light it reaches 3.3:1 on surface-0 and 3.1:1 on surface-1: use it at 12-13px only for non-essential metadata, or at 18px+; in dark it holds 4.7:1 on surface-0.

tokens.name: stroke
tokens.usage: Input borders, card outlines in dark, dividers between sections, chart axes. Decorative: never the only thing that separates two states.

tokens.name: stroke-subtle
tokens.usage: Row dividers, chart gridlines (never heavier than this), the sidebar edge.

tokens.name: stroke-hover
tokens.usage: Input, chip and control borders on hover: one step firmer than stroke, still quieter than text-tertiary. Focus adds the ring; hover only firms the border.

tokens.name: brand-primary
tokens.usage: Moss, the default accent: primary buttons, the selected state, focus rings, checked controls, links, the primary chart series. Replaced at runtime by the chosen accent. As text on surface-0 it is 4.47:1 in light (just under 4.5) and 7.8:1 in dark: for link text at 14px in light prefer brand-hover.

tokens.name: brand-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and active shade of brand-primary on buttons and links; also the safe choice for accent-coloured body text in light (5.7:1 on surface-0).

tokens.name: brand-muted
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind accent chips, the selected row, the success badge and brand-primary text at 13px+ bold or 18px+ (3.9:1 light, 5.3:1 dark).

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Label and icon on a brand-primary fill: white in light (4.9:1 on moss), the page colour in dark (7.8:1 on fern). Never literal white in dark.

tokens.name: ai
tokens.usage: The Gardener's ink: spruce in light, sea-glass in dark. A cooler, bluer green than any accent, chosen so an AI surface reads as green (the garden's own colour) yet is never mistaken for the owner's moss-accented data. Gardener message names, the Gardener chip, tool-card titles, the AI badge. 5.1:1 on ai-muted and 5.5:1 on surface-0 in light; 8.0:1 and 10.9:1 in dark. Honey/firefly from visual-language.md is kept beside it as the secondary pair (honey, honey-muted).

tokens.name: ai-muted
tokens.usage: Ground of every Gardener surface: message bubbles, tool cards, the can-see chip row, proposal cards. Mint in light, deep spruce in dark. Never used for the owner's own data; text-primary stays 12:1 on it in both themes.

tokens.name: honey
tokens.usage: The Gardener's hands: tool cards and the model chip, always inside a green or neutral surface, never the ground of a whole panel. Light: 4.9:1 on honey-muted and 5.6:1 on surface-0 at any weight (the handoff's #8a6a1e sat at 4.05:1, which the 13 px model chip cannot carry); dark: firefly gold, 9.8:1.

tokens.name: honey-muted
tokens.usage: Ground of a tool-call card and the model chip. Never behind the owner's own data.

tokens.name: on-honey
tokens.usage: Label on a solid honey fill (a tool card's confirm button): 5.1:1 light, 12.6:1 dark.

tokens.name: on-ai
tokens.usage: Label on a solid ai fill (the confirm button inside a Gardener tool card): 6.1:1 light, 10.9:1 dark.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive actions, error text and the error toast, the trailing swipe on mobile. 5.2:1 light and 5.9:1 dark on surface-0; on-danger for text on a danger fill.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Label on a danger fill (the destructive confirm button): 5.7:1 light, 5.9:1 dark.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: The act-external access badge, stale integration chips, the 'estimated' expiry badge icon. 3.05:1 in light on surface-0: icons and 18px+ text only, always beside a word. 9.5:1 in dark.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Informational banners and the offline status bar chip. 3.8:1 in light on surface-0: icons, borders and 18px+ text only; 8.1:1 in dark.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success is the accent, never a separate green: the done check, the healthy integration chip, the committed capture. Always paired with a check icon or a word.

tokens.name: accent-moss
tokens.usage: Default accent (equals brand-primary). Light: 4.47:1 on surface-0 as text, 4.9:1 under white; dark: 7.8:1 as text.

tokens.name: accent-fern
tokens.usage: Owner-selectable accent. Light: 3.6:1 as text on surface-0, 4.0:1 under white (large text and fills with 18px+ labels only); dark: 10.5:1.

tokens.name: accent-sage
tokens.usage: Owner-selectable accent. Light: 3.2:1 as text on surface-0, 4.2:1 under text-primary (use dark text on a sage fill in light); dark: 9.8:1.

tokens.name: accent-clay
tokens.usage: Owner-selectable accent and the second categorical chart series. Light: 3.9:1 as text on surface-0, 4.3:1 under white; dark: 6.9:1.

tokens.name: accent-marigold
tokens.usage: Owner-selectable accent and the fourth categorical chart series. Light: 2.7:1 as text on surface-0 (fails even large text), 5.1:1 under text-primary (dark label on a marigold fill); dark: 9.8:1.

tokens.name: accent-lavender
tokens.usage: Owner-selectable accent. Light: 4.0:1 as text on surface-0, 4.4:1 under white; dark: 7.7:1.

tokens.name: accent-plum
tokens.usage: Owner-selectable accent. Light: 6.2:1 as text on surface-0, 6.8:1 under white; dark: 5.4:1 as text, 5.4:1 under surface-0.

tokens.name: accent-sky
tokens.usage: Owner-selectable accent (equals info) and the third categorical chart series. Light: 3.8:1 as text on surface-0, 4.2:1 under white; dark: 8.1:1.

tokens.name: accent-slate
tokens.usage: Owner-selectable accent. Light: 5.0:1 as text on surface-0, 5.5:1 under white; dark: 7.1:1.

tokens.name: accent-rose
tokens.usage: Owner-selectable accent. Light: 4.0:1 as text on surface-0, 4.4:1 under white; dark: 7.0:1.

tokens.name: chart-primary
tokens.usage: The primary series of every numeric widget (the weight line).

tokens.name: chart-reference
tokens.usage: Averages and goal lines, dashed.

tokens.name: chart-series-2
tokens.usage: Second categorical series. At most three categorical series per chart: clay, sky, marigold, in that order.

tokens.name: chart-series-3
tokens.usage: Third categorical series.

tokens.name: chart-series-4
tokens.usage: Fourth categorical series; the last one allowed.

tokens.name: chart-axis
tokens.usage: Axis lines.

tokens.name: chart-grid
tokens.usage: Gridlines; never heavier.

tokens.name: chart-label
tokens.usage: Axis and legend labels.

helpers.name: hover-ink
helpers.usage: The ink that filled controls wash with on hover (6–8%) and press (14%); brand-hover is derived from it for the accents.

helpers.name: meter-track
helpers.usage: The track behind the budget meter in the Gardener chip.

helpers.name: card-border
helpers.usage: The outline of a raised card: barely there in light (the shadow does the work), a firm stroke in dark where there is no shadow.

helpers.name: seg-pill-bg
helpers.usage: The sliding pill of the segmented control: the page colour on the surface-2 track in light, a step up in dark.

helpers.name: scrim
helpers.usage: The backdrop behind a modal sheet.

derivation.note: How an accent other than moss gets its hover and muted shades and its on-brand label colour. Moss keeps the hand-tuned tokens above, and its data-accent block repeats them so data-accent="moss" equals no attribute. on-brand is whichever candidate has the higher contrast on the accent; the report flags any pair under 4.5:1.

type.note: The scale is 12, 13, 14, 15 (voice), 16, 18, 22, 28, 36 and nothing between; the generator refuses any other size. Display styles take their weight, tracking and italic from the face dial.

fonts.note: Self-hosted under the SIL Open Font License; nothing is fetched from a CDN. `shipped` goes into the app; `gallery` exists only for the display-face dial in Storybook.

groups.name: Display
groups.note: The display face is Newsreader (variable, optical size on), declared with ascent-override 98% / descent-override 26% so it shares a baseline with Inter; data-face on the root can swap in Fraunces, Instrument Serif or Bricolage Grotesque (all shipped in fonts/). It is the app's voice: headings, the daily line, buttons, card titles, and every sentence the app says (toasts, notifications, Gardener replies, empty states). Inter stays for the owner's data and anything typed.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: The one title on a full-height screen: onboarding steps, the splash wordmark at 'eden'.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Page header names on desktop; the Sanctuary line at full size.

styles.name: display-md
styles.usage: Empty-state titles, sheet titles, section headings inside a detail pane.

styles.name: display-sm
styles.usage: Widget-sized headings on mobile and in L widgets.

styles.name: voice
styles.usage: A sentence the app says, in the display face so it matches the buttons beside it: toast messages, notification lines, Gardener replies, empty-state and inline-error sentences, popover text. Never for the owner's data, lists, tables or anything typed.

styles.name: daily-line
styles.usage: The daily line on the splash, the Garden and Sanctuary, with its source beneath in caption. Italic is reserved for this style.

styles.name: daily-line-lg
styles.usage: The daily line on the splash and the Sanctuary page: the same italic voice at the display-lg size, still weight 400 and the looser leading.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Inter for everything the display face does not do. Body 14 on desktop, 16 on mobile; line-height 1.5.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: From your stock and three recipes, here are two you can cook tonight.
styles.usage: Body on mobile, onboarding copy, Gardener replies on mobile.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Body on desktop: list primary text, messages, form values, notification lines.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: The secondary line of a row, chip labels, helper text, the audit log.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, segmented-control tabs, field labels, badge text, sidebar items.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Widget title rows, inbox card titles, table headers, detail-pane section titles.

styles.name: title-lg
styles.usage: The title of a detail pane or pushed view.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Domain subtitles, timestamps, the daily line's source, status-bar text. Usually in text-secondary or text-tertiary.

groups.name: Data
groups.note: Geist Mono wherever a number must align or a value is copied: quantities, metrics, code in Toolbench.

styles.name: data-lg
styles.usage: The value in the Quick Log sheet, the headline metric in a widget, the budget meter's figure.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Numbers in tables, quantities in stock rows, costs and token counts.

styles.name: data-sm
styles.usage: Trailing metadata in list rows, times, the unit chip, registry-id counts in the can-see chip.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Code, entity URIs, registry ids and device names in Toolbench and Settings.

spacing.note: Four-pixel base. Component padding 8, 12, 16; section gaps 24, 32.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, the gap between chips.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside chips and compact controls; between a row's primary and secondary line.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Inside buttons and inputs; between rows in a widget body.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card and widget padding, sheet padding on mobile, the page gutter on mobile.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sections inside a page; sheet padding on desktop; the gap between widgets.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between the page header and its content; the page gutter on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, segmented controls, badges, checkboxes, tool cards.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Cards, widgets, inbox cards, Gardener message bubbles, the toast.

tokens.name: radius-sheet
tokens.usage: Sheets, the command palette, the confirm sheet and the app-icon rounded square.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Chips, the unit chip, the can-see chip, the floating + button.

size.note: Fixed dimensions the patterns depend on.

tokens.name: row-comfortable
tokens.usage: List row height in the comfortable density (desktop default).

tokens.name: row-compact
tokens.usage: List row height when the compact setting is on.

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs and segmented controls on desktop; 44px on mobile via touch-target.

tokens.name: touch-target
tokens.usage: Minimum hit area on mobile: rows, buttons, the floating button, swipe actions.

tokens.name: icon-sm
tokens.usage: Lucide in dense rows, chips and badges, with icon-stroke-dense.

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: Lucide in buttons, the sidebar and the status bar, with icon-stroke-dense.

tokens.name: icon-lg
tokens.usage: Lucide and domain glyphs in page headers, widget title rows and empty states, with icon-stroke.

tokens.name: icon-stroke-dense
tokens.usage: Stroke width for 16 and 20 px icons.

tokens.name: icon-stroke
tokens.usage: Stroke width for 24 px icons and every domain glyph.

tokens.name: focus-ring-width
tokens.usage: The keyboard focus ring, in the accent, offset by focus-ring-offset.

tokens.name: focus-ring-offset
tokens.usage: Gap between a focused control and its ring.

tokens.name: widget-columns
tokens.usage: Columns of the Garden grid; widgets are S 1x1, M 2x1, L 2x2.

tokens.name: field-lg
tokens.usage: The large Quick Log value field.

tokens.name: tab-bar
tokens.usage: The mobile bottom tab bar, before the safe-area inset.

tokens.name: fab
tokens.usage: The floating + button on mobile.

tokens.name: sidebar
tokens.usage: The desktop sidebar width.

tokens.name: status-bar
tokens.usage: The desktop status bar height.

tokens.name: sheet-sm
tokens.usage: A small centred sheet: the confirm sheet.

tokens.name: sheet-md
tokens.usage: The default centred sheet and the side sheet: Quick Log.

tokens.name: sheet-max
tokens.usage: The widest sheet: the Capture sheet on desktop.

shadow.note: Elevation is a soft shadow in light only. In dark, elevation is a lighter surface plus a stroke, never a shadow, so both shadow tokens resolve to none there.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Cards, widgets, popovers and the toast in light. In dark, give the same element surface-1 and a stroke border.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: Sheets, the command palette and the confirm sheet in light. In dark, surface-1 with a stroke border.

motion.note: Micro-interactions 150 ms, panels and sheets 220 ms, one ease-out. Under reduced motion the panel, settle and breeze durations drop to zero so only opacity animates.

tokens.name: duration-micro
tokens.usage: Hover washes, colour changes, the focus ring.

tokens.name: duration-panel
tokens.usage: Popovers, sheets, the segmented pill, the selection mark.

tokens.name: duration-settle
tokens.usage: The settle of a completed task or committed capture.

tokens.name: duration-breeze
tokens.usage: The one-shot Breeze specks (D-42).

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: The only easing.

z.note: Overlays live in the browser top layer; these are fallbacks and the app shell order.

breakpoints.note: Numbers in px for tokens.ts and the Tailwind mapping. The kit itself never uses a media query: platform comes from data-platform.

tokens.name: detail
tokens.usage: Below this width the detail pane becomes a pushed view.

platform.note: Set data-platform on the root once per app. Components read only the --ed-* variables these blocks set.

density.note: Desktop only. Compact tightens rows; components hide the detail line themselves.

brand.note: data-brand on the root: how much of the garden shows in the chrome. One level per surface, never mixed on a screen. Components read only these --ed-* variables. Type roles here override the --ed-t-title, --ed-t-voice, --ed-t-button and --ed-t-title-sm variables from the type scale, which is how the display face says things at tended and lush and Inter at plain.

face.note: data-face: the display face, a gallery-only dial. Only newsreader ships in the app (D-39); its values are the defaults in theme.css, the others live in faces.css.

bricolage.family: "Bricolage Grotesque", "Hiragino Sans", "Noto Sans JP", system-ui, sans-serif

relief.note: data-relief: how filled controls sit on the page (OQ-21). raised keeps a toned-down sheen and shadow and presses in (the button sinks by press-y and shrinks by press-scale); flat removes sheen and shadow and only washes on press. Compare both with the Relief toolbar in Storybook; the default is what the app ships until the owner decides.

contrast.note: Pairs the generator measures into tokens-report.md. The accents are measured automatically as text on surface-0 and surface-1, as fills under their computed on-brand, and through their derived hover and muted values.
